artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: run(): a name the store holds (_stored_state, _incremental_plan) is fetched over one window request (ia.request_window, or from the first missing trading day for a gap pull) through fetch_for and _yf_window; on_incremental applies incremental_append.apply_incremental, then append_tr (TR_COLS), then the relock check on the appended window (lock.check when a trade falls in the window; appended_without_relock otherwise), then price_store.write_incremental; a refill_split, a failed relock, an unbuildable TR or a refused write HOLDS the name (hold: receipt held_restatement, the name's files untouched). The receipt is out['incremental'] = {appended, appended_without_relock, held_restatement, keys_written}. A name the store does not hold takes the unchanged full path. The frontier is the last closed session (_closed_frontier, before 21:00 UTC the prior day) when today is not passed. No S3 write, no queue, ledger or pacer write by this module's new code.

write_incremental(root, cusip, appended, lock_row): appends the new prices and dividends and extends lock.json; never writes splits.parquet; refuses (written False, reason) on a stored schema mismatch, a row not dated after the stored max, a gained split, a lock differing in any field but valid_to, a backwards valid_to, or a stored row that would change on re-read. index() reads the names in a 16-thread pool with the same rows and order (_index_row); measured 50.5 s sequential to 4.0 s.

append_tr(stored, window, act, symbol, bbg): tr_column.build over the stored max row plus the new rows (the stored max's close as the prior close), cut to the new dates; the stored splits and the stored plus window dividends are its inputs. TR_COLS constant. apply_incremental itself is unchanged.

--tr compares the TR columns (cash, total_return, tr_source, flags) of the appended rows with tr_column.build over the FULL history (_compare_tr, _tr_rows); --spot N --tr prints {equal, of, tr_cells}; --piece I/K runs one chunk of the stratified sample (_piece_of); the split arm (_split_arm) drives daily_draw.run over a local scratch store with a stub window fetch and requires the held decision, refilled false and the four files byte-identical. The shared pacer is never touched; the scratch pacer is .scratch/incremental_equal_pacer.json.
